methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified via WebFetch on each vendor's official pricing page (browserstack.com/pricing, lambdatest.com/pricing which 301-redirects to testmuai.com/pricing, saucelabs.com/pricing, testingbot.com/pricing, testsigma.com/pricing, browsercloud.io/pricing) on 2026-06-18, corroborated by WebSearch. Compliance verified on dedicated trust/security pages: only frameworks the vendor EXPLICITLY certifies are marked true; 'ready'/cross-referenced frameworks are set null. Two corrections vs. the draft: (1) BrowserStack HIPAA set null - browserstack.com/security lists only SOC2 Type 2, GDPR, CSA STAR; HIPAA is not claimed. (2) TestMu AI HIPAA set null - only 'HIPAA-ready' appears in a framework cross-reference list, not an explicit certification. LambdaTest->TestMu AI 301 redirect confirmed live. CrossBrowserTesting (SmartBear) omitted (not verifiable). TestingBot prices are EUR-only as published; monthlyUsd left null rather than guessing FX. All prices are the lowest published tier per billing cycle; accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: BrowserStack
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from browserstack.com/pricing on 2026-06-18 and corroborated by WebSearch. Compliance from browserstack.com/security, which lists SOC2 Type 2, GDPR, and CSA STAR only. HIPAA is NOT stated and was corrected from true to null. Live individual/team and Automate prices are annual-billing monthly equivalents; Freelancer also shows a $19 month-to-month rate.
